As reported by USA TODAY on Aug. 12, a recent poll from Economist/YouGov placed the president's approval ratings at a "new low," with one in three Americans, or 33%, of respondents approving of his job performance, according to the results. USA TODAY described this as the "lowest approval rating" that the president has seen in YouGov tracking since returning to office in 2025. [...] ## How does Trump's approval rating compare with his first term?

According to results from now-defunct polling website FiveThirtyEight, Trump had a final approval rating of 34% when he left office in 2021. His approval average during his first term was 41%.
